title: Poocha
description: A kid-safe science companion for children aged 8 to 12, fine-tuned from Gemma 4 E2B and E4B. Its persona, Kat, teaches with Indian analogies and routes unsafe questions to a trusted adult.

title: Lambo
description: Agentic graph memory system for AI operations with background concept canonization, structural scoring arithmetic, and blast-radius warnings.

title: Keel
description: Go building blocks for media apps that sit on a public URL and call paid APIs: a rate gate, durable jobs with live progress, a private media store, ffmpeg tied to its job, and cost budgets that refuse before they spend.

title: Chaaya
description: A Svelte 5 kit of behaviour, not looks: theme tokens, audio and still capture, job progress over SSE, uploads, and an API client with typed errors. Each app keeps its own visual identity.

title: Vimanam
description: Turns OpenAPI and Swagger specs (JSON or YAML) into focused, token-budgeted Markdown for people and LLMs, and diffs two versions of a spec, straight from Git refs if needed, flagging breaking changes for CI. Also usable as a Rust library.

title: Sethu
description: Traces OpenAPI changes into a consumer application, repairs the affected code in IBM Bob, and records evidence an independent checker can validate. Built on Vimanam's diffs.

title: Reprise
description: A personal podcast. You talk, a host asks questions, and the conversation becomes an episode. The host remembers earlier episodes, so the show calls back to what you said before.

title: Thutapi
description: A child is interviewed one short question at a time, and the answers become an illustrated, narrated picture book with a PDF and a captioned film.

title: Inner Life
description: An agent that reads a DataHub catalog every day, writes what it found as drama, weather, dream and obituary, with every claim cited, and writes it back so the graph remembers.

title: Orma
description: A daily two-minute accountability call. It rings at a time you chose, leads with what you keep not doing, asks what needs capturing, and hangs up.

title: Mooshik
description: An ambient, local-first cowork partner that sits in a terminal pane beside your editor, holds long-term graph memory across sessions, and acts on your behalf.

title: Ajilamu
description: Dubs creator video into another language and holds every line inside the slot the original speaker left for it, repairing takes that don't fit and recording what every call cost.

title: Seatright
description: A five-seat dark software factory on Band: a coordinator plans, three implementers build in parallel and a reviewer checks every candidate, each in its own Docker Sandbox, from a single dispatch.

title: Auteur
description: Sound design for video where being fussy is free: a silent video becomes a mixed soundtrack in which every sound traces to the call that made it and every placement moves without paying again.

title: Dry Run
description: The interview before the interview. Paste a job posting and Dry Run finds where you're thin, asks grounded questions, and scores your answers against a transparent rubric. A WebMCP app.

title: Rehearsal
description: Paste a job posting and get interviewed on it. Rehearsal researches the role and the company, briefs you on what to study, interviews you aloud and scores your answers.

title: Mosaic
description: A framework for putting generative agents beside a deterministic, auditable core, with streaming state, human gates and immutable provenance, plus a running incident-response reference app.

title: Cerebro EOC
description: An AI emergency operations center: six specialist agent cells reason in parallel on Cerebras the moment an anomaly lands, and a commander synthesizes the operational picture in seconds.

title: Chalachithram
description: Turns a child's story into a short film: character-locked stills, image-to-video, multilingual dialogue and score, all from one film.json. Three films shipped, one in Malayalam.

title: Neom Mathventure
description: A math game built for my children featuring tapir and capybara mascots. The difficulty increases as the child progresses.

title: Sarvam Benchmarks
description: An interactive evaluation dashboard and test explorer benchmarking Sarvam 30B (local and cloud) and Sarvam 105B across 37 test categories including Indic translation, coding, reasoning, and tool use.

title: Rustydocs
description: Finds stale documentation using git history, section by section, with profiles for Hugo, Mintlify, GitBook and Starlight.

title: Pi Model Providers
description: Pi coding-agent extensions that register Sarvam AI and InferX as model providers, with the shims their OpenAI-compatible endpoints need.

title: IBM Bob for Arch Linux
description: Community packaging of the IBM Bob IDE for Arch Linux: an audited RPM repackaging and an AUR release workflow.

title: API Query Builder
description: A dynamic tool that generates complex CLI commands on-the-fly from an OpenAPI specification.

title: Markdown Table Converter
description: Convert fragile Markdown tables into a robust, readable YAML format for Hugo shortcodes.

title: AI Foley
description: Scores silent AI-generated video automatically: a VLM builds an event timeline, each event gets a generated sound effect, and the whole soundtrack re-renders deterministically for fractions of a cent. Superseded by Auteur.
